architectural-decision-records.why: records the coverage-map decision and the test-wiring guard
architectural-decision-records.what: wrote ADR 0067: a three-tier coverage map of what enforces each of the 16 skills, kept honest by a drift test, plus a guard that every test file runs in CI (closing a real gap where 3 test files were unwired)
quotes: Every architecturally significant change ships with an ADR in the same unit of work

verifiable-quality-gates.why: made the map and the test-suite self-proving, and fixed checks that were not actually running
verifiable-quality-gates.what: coverage-map.test.mjs fails if a skill or manifest gate is missing from the map; all-tests-wired.test.mjs fails if any test/*.test.mjs is not in the npm test script; wired the 3 previously-unrun test files in
quotes: replace each check with a no-op and require its test to fail

arch-encode.why: turned the caught test-wiring miss into an enforced rule
arch-encode.what: three test files (gate-matrix, enforcement-nudge, coverage-map) existed but were not in npm test, so the required CI job never ran them; encoded the rule as all-tests-wired.test.mjs so a test on disk can never again be silently skipped
quotes: A rule you can check mechanically is the goal

skeptical-audit.why: the map is honest about what is gated versus judgment; no overclaiming
skeptical-audit.what: classified all 16 skills into travels / local gate / human review, stated plainly that six travel and the judgment tier is not a gap to close, and that a green board means the floors held, not that the work is good
quotes: If you cannot attach all three, you do not assert it

comprehensive-test-strategy.why: added the right tests at the right layer for the map and the wiring invariant
comprehensive-test-strategy.what: unit tests parse the committed map and the committed package.json and assert the invariants (every skill + gate mapped; every test wired), the lowest layer that can catch the respective drift
quotes: Test at the lowest level that can catch the bug

judge-arch.why: reviewed the change in fresh context before the PR
judge-arch.what: ran judge-arch on the coverage map, the two guard tests, and the package.json wiring; recorded in the arch-review log
quotes: These are not optional and not left to discretion

bdd-comprehensive-testing.why: coupling fires on the test-suite change; the invariants are pinned as executable scenarios
bdd-comprehensive-testing.what: the behaviors (the map is missing a skill or gate -> fail; a test file is not wired into npm test -> fail) are written as discriminating node:test checks at the lowest layer that proves them
quotes: These are not optional and not left to judgment. Every time this

enterprise-architecture-standards.why: no system/data architecture or code change

pattern-selector.why: no feature, class, module, or data flow designed

release-deployment-safety.why: no deploy, migration, or feature flag

sre-operational-readiness.why: no runtime service, SLI/SLO, or alerting surface

compliance-data-lifecycle.why: no personal data, retention, or schema/data migration

universal-accessibility-wcag.why: no user-facing UI; a Markdown map and tests

usability-ux-universal-design.why: no user-facing UI or workflow for people; an internal reference doc
